admission.justification: Spans dashboard launcher generations: feature parity through model/effort changes with visible defaults and provenance is what lets FAM-GDXSJG propagate behavior changes without silent launcher drift.

applicability: Every dashboard role launch through the single extracted launcher.
conditions: Ordinary model/effort changes preserve the five existing operands including featureValues.
After step-up, base chips and speed controls are non-applied previews, not evidence of selected-host mode/features.
Observed model/source come from the receipt; unreported mode/features remain explicitly unknown.
exclusions: Merging host-offered speed controls into permission policy.
A second launcher source of truth.
statement: The single extracted dashboard launcher preserves ordinary selected features through model/effort changes with visible default provenance. A stepped-up receipt instead labels base choices as non-applied previews and displays only reported step-up observations; speed remains separate from permission policy.
